packing: • Madeira ridge kit: wind layer, rain shell, warm mid-layer and real headlamp; coast weather is not summit weather.
• Ionian swim kit: water shoes, sun shirt, reef-safe sunscreen and motion-sickness plan for the Zakynthos boat.
• Driving: International Driving Permit, automatic-car confirmation and offline maps for both islands.

days.heading: Depart Pittsburgh after work

facts.label: Route

days.note: Sleep on the aircraft; do not count this as a hotel night.

days.heading: Arrive Funchal, keep the first evening soft

facts.label: Drive

spots.cost: Monte cable car is a paid first-day view; plan roughly €15–20 per adult one-way and reconfirm the 2027 family fare. Old Town wandering is free.
spots.climate: Funchal’s June normal is mild rather than beach-hot: about 65–75°F at the coast. Treat this as the scenery/hiking chapter; Porto Moniz is a conditional lava-pool dip, not the warm-swim promise.

facts.label: Rule
facts.valueHtml: No full traverse without live status, wind check and family energy

days.note: Use the clear morning; never force it.

spots.name: Pico do Arieiro – Pico Ruivo ridge: a weather-window hike

spots.cost: Classified PR trails currently require a reservation/fee; confirm the 2027 slot, trail status, tunnel access, and child rules before committing. Parking and a rental car make an early attempt practical.
spots.climate: Mountain weather is not Funchal weather. It can be cold, windy and inside cloud above 1,800 m even on a warm coast day. Start only with a clear live status and a turn-around rule; Balcões is the family-safe fallback.
spots.saveHtml: Save Drive yourselves before sunrise rather than buying four transfer seats, and carry packed breakfasts.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge A private guide only if the actual PR1 route and weather make the family want navigation support.
spots.restoHtml:
• Arieiro café — simple hot drinks and snacks after the start.

  • Funchal apartment dinner — the reliable recovery option.
spots.altboxHtml:
• PR11 Levada dos Balcões if cloud, wind, or the 8-year-old’s appetite makes ridge exposure a poor fit.

spots.saveHtml: Save Do the short out-and-back to the best viewpoint instead of forcing the full hot traverse.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge A final Madeiran dinner in Machico/Funchal after an early return and packing night.

• O Pescador, Machico — grilled chicken, fries and fish.

days.heading: Myrtos reveal, then Assos harbor

facts.label: Swim
facts.valueHtml: Myrtos is a wade/photo stop; Assos is the calmer option

days.note: The home-card day: cliffs first, harbor lunch second.

spots.name: Myrtos cliff-road reveal, then Assos harbor
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · madeiraIG · kefaloniaIG · ionianFlickr

images.alt: myrtos cliff view

spots.cost: Myrtos viewpoints and Assos wandering are free; budget sunbeds/parking only if used. Myrtos’s steep shelf and changing swell make it a look/wade beach for the younger child, not the primary swim.
spots.climate: June is warm and dry on Kefalonia: plan around roughly 78–84°F air and 72–74°F sea as historical proxies. Mornings are likelier to be calmer; west-facing exposure can build later.
spots.saveHtml: Save Lead with the free cliff-road photo and have lunch in Assos rather than renting Myrtos sunbeds all day.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Assos harbor lunch at a waterside taverna after the viewpoint.
spots.restoHtml:
• Platanos, Assos — pizza, pasta and grilled options.
  • Nefeli-Anait, Assos — simple taverna dishes and fries.
  • Sami groceries — pack water and beach food.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Assos harbor swim if Myrtos surf is up.
  • Skip the beach descent if parking/heat makes the cliff view enough.

spots.saveHtml: Save Use the current combined-ticket discount and bring your own lunch for Antisamos afterward.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private transfer/guide only if avoiding parking and timing stress is worth it.
spots.restoHtml:
• Contessina, Sami — pizza, pasta and harbor seating.
  • Tereza, Sami — pizza/café fallback.
  • Karavomylos picnic — keeps the caves schedule flexible.

• Antisamos first if cruise/coach congestion makes the cave queues unpleasant.

spots.restoHtml:
• Irida’s, Fiskardo — pizza, pasta and harbor tables.
  • Apagio, Fiskardo — grilled chicken/fish and fries.
  • Sami bakery stop — trail snacks for the drive.

days.heading: Antisamos: the calm-swim reset

facts.label: Sea
facts.valueHtml: Historical June proxy 72–74°F; daily flags win

days.note: A true beach day before the boat.

spots.name: Antisamos: the easy, green-backed family swim day
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · madeiraIG · kefaloniaIG · ionianFlickr

antisamos cove

spots.cost: Beach access is free; budget optional sunbeds, snacks and fuel. This is the scheduled easy swim day rather than a decorative beach stop.
spots.climate: Historical June sea temperature is about 72–74°F. Antisamos is a more manageable swim choice than Myrtos, but real wind, flags and sea state still win on the day.
spots.saveHtml: Save Bring shade/snacks and use the free beach rather than a beach-club package.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Rent two sunbeds/umbrella for the all-day reset.
spots.restoHtml:
• Antisamos beach café — sandwiches, fries and simple beach food.
  • Tereza, Sami — pizza at the end of the day.
  • AB / Lidl, Argostoli — full grocery reset if needed.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Karavomylos waterfront for a calmer, shorter swim.
  • Indoor cave timing if a hot afternoon needs shade.

days.heading: Zakynthos boat: Navagio water-view + Blue Caves

facts.label: Constraint
facts.valueHtml: Navagio landing is unconfirmed/likely restricted; do not promise it

days.note: Book only after 2027 access and sea-state terms are clear.

spots.name: Zakynthos day boat: Navagio viewpoint-from-water + Blue Caves
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · madeiraIG · kefaloniaIG · ionianFlickr

images.alt: navagio aerial

spots.cost: Budget a pre-booked full-day boat from Kefalonia. Navagio landing/swimming has been closed under a 2026 landslide safety decision; treat any 2027 cove access as unknown until the operator and authority confirm it. The honest plan is water viewing plus Blue Caves.
spots.climate: Early sea is smoother. This is a motion-sickness and wind-sensitive day; choose a licensed operator with cancellation/refund terms and make Antisamos the no-boat fallback.
spots.saveHtml: Save Book a standard shared boat with a clear Navagio-closure policy rather than paying for a promised landing that may be illegal.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Small-group boat with shade, swim ladder and hotel transfer.
spots.restoHtml:
• Pack sandwiches — boat-day food is usually expensive and limited.
  • Sami pizza — simple recovery dinner after the water.
  • Argostoli bakery — use it for a shore-day fallback picnic.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Antisamos + Sami if weather cancels the boat.
  • Blue Caves only if Navagio restrictions remove the full-day value.
